== Summary ==
Composed source-region render for [[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata)]], original page 7 of [[:File:Virtual-Set-8-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-7-extract.pdf]]. Original page7 is a complete raster image (xref1040), rectangle <code>[214.667, 42, 394, 283.333]</code>, rendered at 745/rectangle-width scale. The caption identifies the Light Side host. First publication day unknown; the original complete PDF is preserved at [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005192157id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-8.pdf the immutable 5 October 2021 capture]. Source PDF SHA-256 <code>7c9bcdab4cba33e1af1225c88cd3b0aa6e73839dd3e01658d33369b9f7391cde</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
